about: Judge regression fixtures. One entry = one stored input a judge is handed + the verdict it must return. Doc: docs/judge-fixtures.md. Scoring: server/lib/judgeFixtures.js. Runner: scripts/admin/judge-fixtures.js. Every image was looked at (full pixels) before its expectation was written; `source` says where the expected verdict comes from.

Fiona p7 shipped plate (close-up on the cutter deck). STRUCTURES gave the author VEH001 "weathered wooden pirate cutter": a weathered dark brown wooden ship with a single tall mast, square rigged grey sails, and thick wooden rowing benches along the open deck. Signature: single tall thick wooden mast. The plate text puts the deck and its tall thick central mast in frame; the pixels show a plank deck with one thick mast rising centrally (full image checked). A structures charge here is false.

Fiona p9 shipped plate: aboard=VEH001, so STRUCTURES told the author to render the deck, rail and fittings around the camera, never the hull. The pixels show the cutter's wooden bow and deck boards in the foreground under a bridge arch, no mast in view (camera looks forward). Only the part the camera sees is judged: not missing, not another kind. (The plate has other defects — distant people, modern station — this fixture scopes to structures only.)

Goldene Möwe story p1 shipped plate (wide, harbour quay). STRUCTURES gave the author VEH001 Goldene Möwe: a two-masted wooden sailing ship, deep forest-green hull with a thin gold stripe, white gull figurehead, off-white canvas sails, bowsprit. The pixels show exactly that ship moored at the quay, matching its Visual Bible render too (both viewed). A structures charge here is false.

Goldene Möwe story p16 shipped plate (per-page, not derived). Its plate text puts the chest in wet sand "between two wooden ships", and STRUCTURES gave the author both: the green-hulled Goldene Möwe and the black Schwarze Nadel. The pixels show only the black ship with dark sails (the same image as p15, md5-identical); the green ship the plate text puts in view is missing.
